title: The web app runs locally without AWS
description:
As a user without an AWS account, I want to run the full web app on my own library.

```gherkin
Feature: The web app on a local library
  Scenario: Edit a slice in the browser
    Given apricitus serve running on a migrated library
    When I open the web app and rename a slice
    Then that slice's record in the library has the new name
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: apricity serve runs the full web app on a local library, no AWS needed.
